cohort: 110 neonates born at Ulin General Hospital, Banjarmasin, between January 2020 and October 2021, divided into two groups based on maternal obesity status.
finding: Babies born to obese mothers were more likely to be delivered by C-section, have excessive birth weight, experience health problems, and have a longer hospital stay.
mod_finding: 100% of babies born to obese mothers were delivered by C-section.
birth_weight: Birth weight was measured, with 12.7% of babies born to obese mothers having excessive birth weight.
